positions.summary_short: Del Duca is running on a 0% property tax increase with no service cuts, more police patrols, more road-building, and lower development charges.
summary_bullets: Delivered a 2026 city budget with 0% property tax increase and no service cuts.
Pushing for more police patrols in neighbourhoods.
Building more roads to make commutes easier.
Reducing the cost of new housing through development-charge cuts.
positions.verbatim_quote: Steven is focused on delivering real results, like delivering a 2026 city budget with no property tax increase and no service cuts, pushing hard for more police patrols in our neighbourhoods, building more roads to make commutes easier, and reducing the cost of new housing.
positions.source_title: Steven Del Duca campaign site: 2026 re-election priorities

positions.summary_short: Del Duca's traffic plan centres on specific road and bridge builds: Teston Road extension, widening the Highway 7 rail bridge, and completing the Bass Pro Mills extension over Highway 400.
summary_bullets: Opened the Kirby Road Extension and Canada Drive Bridge; started the Bass Pro Mills Drive Extension.
Next: extend Teston Rd between Keele St and Dufferin St, widen the rail bridge over Highway 7, and finish the Bass Pro Mills Extension over Highway 400.
Wants jurisdiction of key regional roads transferred to Vaughan to fight gridlock.
positions.verbatim_quote: Next, we need to start the extension of Teston Rd between Keele St. and Dufferin St., widen the rail bridge over Highway 7 at finish the Bass Pro Mills Extension over Highway 400. I'll keep pushing to build the road, bridges and transit Vaughan needs to reduce gridlock and give residents more time back in their day.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Del Duca's housing plan is to cut development charges and build the roads, water infrastructure, parks and community facilities needed to unlock new homes alongside construction.
summary_bullets: Led the way on cutting development charges, 'a tax on new homebuyers', to lower the cost of building.
Helped secure approx $700 million in funding for roads, water infrastructure, parks and community facilities to unlock new housing.
Focus for next four years: get these projects built alongside new homes to build complete communities.
positions.verbatim_quote: That's why I led the way on cutting development charges, a tax on new homebuyers, to lower the cost of building and get more homes built. That leadership helped secure approx $700 million in funding to advance the roads, water infrastructure, parks and community facilities needed to unlock new housing.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Del Duca touts two new YRP substations and hundreds of new police positions, and wants more front-line resources plus federal bail reform.
summary_bullets: Opened two new York Regional Police substations and supported hundreds of new police positions.
Wants more front-line police resources and 'real bail reform' that keeps repeat violent offenders off the streets.
positions.verbatim_quote: We've opened two new YRP substations and supported hundreds of new police positions to strengthen community safety. But there is more to do. I'll keep pushing for more front-line resources and real bail reform that keeps repeat violent offenders off our streets.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Cerrelli would fix traffic bottlenecks, re-time signals, coordinate with York Region on transit, and tie new development to infrastructure capacity.
summary_bullets: Prioritize fixing traffic bottlenecks, better-timed signals, safer intersections.
Stronger coordination with York Region on major roads and transit.
Better transit connections; safer walking and cycling.
New development must be tied to realistic transportation and infrastructure capacity, not approved in isolation.
positions.verbatim_quote: Vaughan needs transportation planning that keeps pace with growth. I would prioritize fixing traffic bottlenecks, better-timed signals, safer intersections and stronger coordination with York Region on major roads and transit.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Cerrelli would cut municipal costs and approval delays, expand purpose-built rentals and attainable ownership, and direct density to areas with infrastructure capacity.
summary_bullets: Reduce unnecessary municipal costs and approval delays.
Expand purpose-built rentals and attainable ownership options.
Partner with other governments and non-profits on affordable housing.
Direct new housing to areas where roads, water, sewers, transit and services can support it; protect established neighbourhoods from unsustainable development.
positions.verbatim_quote: I would make housing more affordable by reducing unnecessary municipal costs and approval delays, expanding purpose-built rentals and attainable ownership options, and partnering with other governments and non-profits on affordable housing.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Cerrelli would strengthen collaboration with York Regional Police, invest in safer streets and prevention programs, and protect places of worship and schools.
summary_bullets: Strengthen collaboration with York Regional Police.
Invest in safer streets and neighbourhoods; support prevention and community-based programs.
Protect places of worship, schools and other vulnerable community spaces while respecting lawful expression.
positions.verbatim_quote: I would strengthen collaboration with York Regional Police, invest in safer streets and neighbourhoods, and support prevention and community-based programs.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Cerrelli would set clear City objectives, report progress publicly, and make decisions easier for residents to understand and join.
summary_bullets: Set clear objectives and report progress publicly on City goals.
Make significant decisions easier for residents to understand and participate in.
Runs to bring 'greater transparency, accountability and resident-focused leadership' to City Hall.
positions.verbatim_quote: Set clear objectives, report progress publicly and make significant decisions easier for residents to understand and participate in.
positions.source_title: Shelly Cerrelli campaign site: Priorities - Accountable City Hall

positions.summary_short: Cerrelli's NextGen Initiative would link young residents with local employers and mentors so they can build careers close to home.
summary_bullets: NextGen Initiative would connect young residents with local employers, mentors and practical experience.
Helps young people begin careers and build businesses close to home.
Bring together the City, local businesses, educational institutions and community organizations for training, internships, apprenticeships and mentorship.
positions.verbatim_quote: Shelly's proposed NextGen Initiative would connect young residents with local employers, mentors and practical experience—helping them begin their careers and build businesses close to home.
positions.source_title: Shelly Cerrelli campaign site: Priorities - NextGen Vaughan

positions.summary_short: Nascimben would review development charges and municipal fees, freeze stormwater charges, and push attainable housing backed by infrastructure.
summary_bullets: Review development charges and municipal fees; advocate attainable housing for families, workers and seniors.
Freeze unnecessary increases and freeze or remove stormwater charges while protecting flood control and critical infrastructure.
Support responsible growth backed by infrastructure.
positions.verbatim_quote: I will advocate for attainable housing so Vaughan's families, workers, and seniors can afford to live in the community they call home. I will review development charges & municipal fees, support responsible growth, and ensure new housing is backed by infrastructure.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Nascimben would increase safety measures with YRP, improve lighting, invest in youth crime-prevention programs, and combat antisemitism and hate.
summary_bullets: Increased community safety measures; stronger partnerships with York Regional Police.
Better lighting and public infrastructure; investments in youth programs to prevent crime.
Support multicultural and faith communities; combat antisemitism and hate.
positions.verbatim_quote: I will advocate for increased community safety measures, stronger partnerships with York Regional Police, better lighting and public infrastructure, and investments in youth programs that help prevent crime before it starts.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Siadatan would use data-driven Smart City solutions, signal coordination and better YRT/Viva service to cut congestion, with infrastructure planned alongside growth.
summary_bullets: Better traffic-signal coordination; reliable YRT/Viva service; improved road planning.
Safer walking and cycling options; data-driven Smart City solutions to reduce congestion.
Transportation and infrastructure planned together as Vaughan grows.
positions.verbatim_quote: As a professional engineer, I would advocate for data-driven Smart City solutions to reduce congestion and improve traffic flow. As Vaughan grows, transportation and infrastructure must be planned together for safe and efficient travel.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Siadatan supports reducing approval delays and encouraging diverse, attainable housing in transit-served areas coordinated with infrastructure.
summary_bullets: Reduce unnecessary approval delays.
Encourage diverse and attainable housing options.
Better use of areas served by transit and existing infrastructure.
Coordinate growth with roads, transit, water, parks, schools and services.
positions.verbatim_quote: I would support reducing unnecessary approval delays, encouraging diverse and attainable housing options, and making better use of areas served by transit and existing infrastructure.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Gordon would push for more GO stations, bus routes and transit lines with investment across transportation modes.
summary_bullets: Work toward more GO stations, more bus routes and transit lines.
Invest in a variety of modes of transportation to keep people connected safely and reliably.
positions.verbatim_quote: As a Regional Councillor, I want to work towards more Go stations, more bus routes, and transit lines. As our communities grow, we need to ensure that we invest in a variety of modes of transportation to keep people connected and get them moving in a safe, seamless and reliable way.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Gordon wants a housing strategy with more options including mid-rise, no new property taxes, and a path to home ownership for young families.
summary_bullets: Housing strategy focused on more options including mid-rise housing.
No new property taxes for residents.
Create a pathway to home ownership for young families; fewer families waiting for affordable housing.
positions.verbatim_quote: We need a housing strategy in Vaughan that focuses on increasing housing options including mid-rise housing. We need to maintain no new property taxes for residents. We need to create a pathway to home ownership for young families and lessen the number of families and individuals waiting for affordable housing.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Jackson supported a development-charge deferral to lower new-housing costs and wants streamlined approvals plus affordable options for families and seniors.
summary_bullets: Supported a Development Charges deferral to lower upfront costs for new housing.
Advocate streamlined approvals and partnerships with other levels of government.
More affordable options for families, seniors and first-time buyers.
positions.verbatim_quote: I supported a Development Charges (DC) deferral to help lower upfront costs for new housing and ease financial pressures on homebuyers.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Jackson, as Vice Chair of the YRP Services Board, backs community-based policing and crime prevention partnerships.
summary_bullets: Vice Chair of the York Regional Police Services Board.
Committed to community-based policing, crime prevention, and police-resident-organization partnerships.
positions.verbatim_quote: As Vice Chair of the York Regional Police Services Board (YRPSB), I am committed to building a safe, welcoming, and inclusive Vaughan. I support community-based policing, crime prevention, and strong partnerships between police, residents, and local organizations.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Rai supports cutting approval delays, more housing options near transit, and growth coordinated with infrastructure.
summary_bullets: Reduce unnecessary approval delays.
Encourage a wider range of housing options; better use of transit-served areas.
Coordinate growth with roads, transit, water, parks and services while respecting established neighbourhoods.
positions.verbatim_quote: As Local and Regional Councillor, I would support practical measures that help reduce unnecessary approval delays, encourage a wider range of housing options, and make better use of areas served by transit.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Rai backs well-resourced police and paramedics, safer roads and school zones, and accessible youth and seniors programs.
summary_bullets: Well-resourced York Regional Police and paramedic services.
Safer roads and school zones; well-maintained parks.
Accessible programs for youth, seniors, families and people with disabilities.
positions.verbatim_quote: I would support well-resourced York Regional Police and paramedic services, safer roads and school zones, well-maintained parks, and accessible programs for youth, seniors, families and people with disabilities.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Racco wants more housing supply with attainable options for first-time buyers and seniors, especially around transit.
summary_bullets: Increase housing supply, including more attainable options for first-time buyers, young families, seniors and downsizers.
Better use of existing infrastructure; right mix of housing, particularly around transit.
positions.verbatim_quote: We need to increase housing supply, including more attainable options for first-time buyers, young families, seniors and those looking to downsize.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Racco would keep working with YRP on crime prevention and stand against antisemitism and hate.
summary_bullets: Continue working with York Regional Police and community organizations on crime and prevention.
Stand up against antisemitism and every form of hate.
positions.verbatim_quote: We must also stand up against antisemitism and every form of hate.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Sandhu would extend rapid transit north from the VMC along Highway 7/Jane, boost YRT/Viva frequency, build protected bike lanes, and fix signal timing at chronic bottlenecks.
summary_bullets: Extend rapid transit north from Vaughan Metropolitan Centre along Hwy 7/Jane St.
Boost YRT/Viva frequency on major arterials; expand park-and-ride and shuttle service.
Build protected bike lanes linking neighbourhoods to GO/subway stations.
Fix signal timing at bottlenecks like Hwy 7, Rutherford and Weston Rd.
positions.verbatim_quote: I'd extend rapid transit north from VMC along Hwy 7/Jane St, boost YRT/Viva frequency on major arterials, build protected bike lanes linking neighbourhoods to GO/subway stations, expand park-and-ride and shuttle service, and fix signal timing at chronic bottlenecks like Hwy 7, Rutherford, and Weston Rd.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Sandhu would prioritize missing-middle housing near transit, speed up approvals, and streamline secondary suites for gentle density.
summary_bullets: Prioritize missing-middle housing (townhomes, secondary suites) near transit.
Speed up approvals; require purpose-built rental near transit.
Streamline secondary-suite approvals for gentle density in existing neighbourhoods.
positions.verbatim_quote: I'd build on this by prioritizing missing-middle housing (townhomes, secondary suites) near transit, speeding up approvals so savings reach buyers, requiring purpose-built rental near transit, and streamlining secondary-suite approvals for gentle density in existing neighbourhoods.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses

positions.summary_short: Sandhu would invest in libraries and rec centres, fund neighbourhood policing liaisons with traffic-calming, and improve pedestrian safety near schools.
summary_bullets: Invest in libraries and rec centres in fast-growing areas.
Fund neighbourhood policing liaison programs alongside traffic-calming (speed humps, lit crosswalks).
Improve pedestrian safety near schools and seniors' facilities.
positions.verbatim_quote: I'd invest in libraries and rec centres in fast-growing areas, fund neighbourhood policing liaison programs alongside traffic-calming like speed humps and lit crosswalks, expand multicultural and settlement services for newcomers, and improve pedestrian safety near schools and seniors' facilities.
positions.source_title: Vaughan Public Libraries 2026 election questionnaire: candidate responses
